scope: bounded Unix terminal reader wake and joined shutdown
review_statement: Approved for committing this bounded Unix reader slice. No remaining blocking findings. Source/vendor patches, executable receipts, raw measurements, screenshot exception, ownership checks and pre-existing workspace failures verified. This approval does not establish completion of the broader rewrite.
resolved_findings: Rejected the finite outer parser drain because it could strand privately buffered input.
Allocate the wake pipe before SIGWINCH registration so failed setup does not retain a signal action.
Capture hangup stderr and require a typed reader error with normal error exit.
Cap fixture quit bursts so a teardown frame is not mistaken for another session.
Retain and explain the two elapsed-clock digit differences; do not replace raw captures.
remaining: 50% source reduction and remaining state/text implementation replacement
sustained runtime CPU targets and long-duration resources
five stale CLI fixture failures with isolated configuration
non-Unix timed reader and unverified other platforms
full feature, live-provider and legacy-removal review
